unprofiled_natural25_denominator.protocol: Canonical ten-prompt, four-category, train/heldout natural25 transition wall; candidate-local warmup for llama.cpp budget selection.

call_normalization.purpose: Separate shader/kernel efficiency from different speculative topology and first-graph capture. Values are ranking diagnostics, not throughput.

vulkan_b3_target.observed_target_graph_shapes: n=36 prompt plus three n=2 and seven n=4 query groups; the 17/19 draft ledger implies one real n=2 and six real n=4 target passes, with two n=2 and one n=4 groups attributable to first-shape graph construction. Shape-free rows have eleven graph occurrences.
vulkan_b3_target.matched_module_rule: Compare hipEngine's seven rows=4 target passes with seven Vulkan n=4 equivalents. Shape-free target operations are multiplied by 7/11. The six-call Vulkan target root n=4 row is multiplied by 7/6.

vulkan_b3_draft.rule: Exclude n=36 draft prefill rows; multiply shape-free operations by 30/31. Root/TOP_K is call-normalized from 22 to hipEngine's 21 root calls for its module row.

vulkan_b4_decode.rule: Keep the one real n=3 and five real n=5 target groups, multiply shape-free target operations by 6/10, and remove n=36 draft/target prefill rows.
vulkan_b4_decode.explanation: The normalized B4 decode residual is 11.44%, while the raw full-request query sum reconciles within 5.83%. The excess is explicitly attributed to first-shape graph construction and shape-free-operation allocation uncertainty; B4 is used for topology direction, not matched module timing.

proposal_module_ledger.protocol: hipEngine proposal plus proposal_update kernels versus the Vulkan draft-context decode estimate; Vulkan root/TOP_K is normalized from 22 to 21 calls.

target_module_ledger.protocol: Seven rows=4 target passes. Fused/unfused operations are grouped at equivalent semantic boundaries; all rows plus the explicit remainder sum exactly to each normalized target GPU total.

complete_decode_kernel_ledger.status: hipengine GPU kernels are faster in aggregate
complete_decode_kernel_ledger.caveat: The Vulkan value is query-interval GPU work and hipEngine is summed rocprof kernel duration; use directionally after each profiler reconciles to its own wall, not as a throughput ratio.

ranked_deficits.evidence: Capture-normalized hipEngine nonkernel residual 65.134 ms versus Vulkan B3 inferred 23.789 ms; this nearly equals the 43.664-ms natural matched-B3 wall gap.

decision.finding: The refreshed exhaustive ledger reverses the old interpretation: hipEngine already uses about 31.2 ms less call-normalized GPU kernel time than Vulkan B3, but loses the complete wall in graph/queue/host scheduling. The steady normalized nonkernel residual gap is about 41.35 ms, almost the complete 43.66-ms matched-B3 natural wall deficit.
decision.module_rule: Every slower semantic module remains a closure item, but arithmetic closure alone is insufficient. Treat graph/queue/host scheduling as the first and largest module; then close Q5 ssm_out, Q6 FFN-down, full-attention K/V, linear-attention Q6 qkv, and target root in descending gap order.
decision.selected_b4_implication: Vulkan B4 saves one target cycle: normalized target GPU work falls from about 275.59 to 246.21 ms while draft work rises from 65.22 to 71.69 ms. This topology shift, not a new shader, is why selected B4 remains the final endpoint.
decision.next_action: Inspect the exact Vulkan command-buffer submission and hipEngine steady target graph gap distribution before another arithmetic port. A candidate must materially reduce the approximately 5.2-5.6 ms internal gap per steady 835-dispatch target replay; graph upload and four-way graph splitting are already measured and rejected.

notes: GGML_VK_PERF_LOGGER synchronizes query reads and is not a throughput benchmark.
The Vulkan query contexts include prompt-prefill work. Call normalization removes the explicit n=36 rows and allocates shape-free operation rows by graph occurrence counts.

The hipEngine first target and first commit markers include graph-capture construction. The steady normalization replaces each with the mean of passes 2-7 without changing source or claiming throughput.
The target module remainder is explicit so semantic rows sum to both normalized target totals; no unseen positive bucket is hidden by dropping unmatched operations.

Natural25 throughput remains sourced from benchmarks/results/2026-08-05-qwen36-27b-journal-snapshot-copy-retained.json and benchmarks/results/2026-08-06-qwen36-27b-llamacpp-vulkan-c8e03ce81-refresh.json.
